column4: prop:clifford-locally-rf preamble: "where tgt^{-1}=alpha(g) on the level-zero copy of Gamma, so that V is the ascending HNN extension of Gamma along alpha and T_alpha = union t^{-n} Gamma t^n." Already-landed carrier.
Put X=V/Gamma, the left-coset space. Pure naming; X is Cosets alpha halpha, the root coset Gamma in X is rootCoset alpha halpha.
The Clifford lamp group Cl(X) is the group with generators epsilon and c_x... relations. Already-landed carrier.
fix a total order on X, let F_2^(X) be the F_2-vector space..., put B(f,g)=sum_{x>y}f(x)g(y). Pure setup naming the cocycle B=crossing; no independent content beyond the object it names.
Since B is bilinear, (a,f)(b,g)=(a+b+B(f,g),f+g) is a group law..., central involution..., commutator is (1,0). Already-landed carrier.
So epsilon -> (1,0), c_x -> (0,delta_x) defines a homomorphism Cl(X) -> F_2 x F_2^(X). Already-landed carrier.
The relations let us write every element... uniquely..., the homomorphism is an isomorphism. Already-landed carrier.
for a finite subset Y, the subgroup generated by epsilon and c_y has order 2^(|Y|+1), so Cl(X) is countable and locally finite. Already-landed carrier.

Killing epsilon leaves F_2^(X) = +_X C_2, so Cl(X) is a central extension of +_X C_2 by C_2, and W below is a central extension of the permutational wreath product C_2 wr_X V by <epsilon>. New theorem in this landing covers the Cl(X) half exactly (config-projection surjective onto X ->0 ZMod 2, its fibre over 0 is exactly {1,sign}, sign central). RESIDUAL: the W/wreath-product half is NOT formalized -- it needs a permutational-wreath-product structure on (X ->0 ZMod 2) rtimes V that is not otherwise part of the repository's route to the manuscript's conclusions (which goes through Ambient/toModel directly); building it would be new infrastructure disproportionate to this one expository remark. Flagging for the lead in case another lane already has wreath-product machinery to reuse.
The relations are invariant under permutations of X, so every permutation of X induces an automorphism of Cl(X)... fixes epsilon. Already-landed carrier.
In this way V acts on Cl(X) through its action on X, and we put W=Cl(X) rtimes V. Already-landed carrier.

prop:clifford-self-embedding statement: "The group W is not MF. More precisely, every homomorphism from W to an MF group kills epsilon." Already leanverified in the tex; carriers are at the printed generality (countable Kazhdan Gamma, injective non-surjective alpha, a outside range alpha).

prop:clifford-self-embedding proof, sentence 1: "Identify Gamma with its level-zero copy in V<=W, and let c be the lamp at the root coset Gamma in X; it centralizes Gamma, which fixes that coset." New theorem in this landing, projecting MarkedCompression.comm_c (centralizes) and MarkedCompression.iotaVertical_smul_rootCoset (fixes the root coset) together.
Then tct^{-1} is the lamp at tGamma and a(tct^{-1})a^{-1} is the lamp at atGamma. Already-landed carrier.
These cosets are distinct, because tGamma=atGamma would mean a in tGamma t^{-1}=alpha(Gamma). Already-landed carrier.

so x=tct^{-1} and y=axa^{-1} are distinct lamps, involutions with [x,y]=epsilon != 1. New theorem in this landing: x^2=1, y^2=1 (conjugate of an involution), [x,y]=signAmbient (via commutator_conjugate_eq_commutator_sq_of_sq_eq_one composed with sign_eq_pointDefect_sq), signAmbient != 1, and x != y follows algebraically (x=y would force [x,y]=1 != epsilon).

Then d=[x,a]=xy and d^2=xyxy=[x,y]=epsilon. New theorem in this landing, chaining CompressionDefectSquare.commutator_eq_mul_conj (d=xy), commutator_conjugate_eq_commutator_sq_of_sq_eq_one (d^2=[x,y]) and CliffordWitnessDirectDefect.sign_eq_pointDefect_sq (d^2=epsilon) -- the exact three-step factorization the printed proof names.

and d=[tct^{-1},a] is a generator of D_W(Gamma), since tGamma t^{-1}<=Gamma, c in C_W(Gamma), and a in Gamma. Already-landed carriers: the three "since" clauses are stable_mem_compressionSet and lamp_mem_centralizer verbatim; pointDefect_mem_printedDefect is the "is a generator of" conclusion built from them.
So <epsilon> <= D_W(Gamma). Already-landed carrier.

The subgroup <epsilon> is central, so normal, and it is finite, so it has property (T). New theorem in this landing, bundling signAmbient_central, the signSubgroup_normal and signSubgroup_finite instances, and hasKazhdanPropertyT_of_finite applied to signSubgroup.
So Theorem compression-criterion applies to the countable group W with L=Gamma and K=<epsilon>: every homomorphism from W to an MF group is trivial on epsilon. Already-landed carrier (leanverified).
In particular, W is not MF. Already-landed carrier (leanverified).

prop:clifford-locally-rf full statement (hypotheses: Gamma residually finite, [Gamma:alpha(Gamma)]<infinity; conclusions: W=W_0 rtimes Z decomposition, W_0 locally RF, W sofic not MF, trace conclusions). Already leanverified in the tex.

prop:clifford-locally-rf proof, sentence 1: "Reassociating the semidirect products yields W=W_0 rtimes Z, W_0=Cl(X) rtimes T_alpha." Already-landed carrier (Sofic/CliffordWitnessSoficSentences.lean), also leanverified via CliffordWitnessLocallyRFByInt.manuscriptAmbientEquivShiftKernelForByInt.
Since [Gamma:alpha(Gamma)]<infinity, each Gamma_n has finite index in Gamma_{n+1}; every element of T_alpha lies in some Gamma_m,... so Gamma is commensurated by V. Already-landed carrier.

Embedded justification clause of the commensuration sentence: "conjugation by t maps Gamma_{m+1} onto Gamma_m." Already-landed carrier at the level-zero representative instance (conjugating the vertical base by the stable letter gives exactly the compressed range); the periodic pattern at general m is the same conjugation identity iterated, consumed internally by vertical_le_commensurator's proof rather than restated at each m.
Hence the stabilizer in Gamma_n of every point of X=V/Gamma has finite index, and every Gamma_n-orbit in X is finite. Already-landed carrier.
A finite subset of W_0 involves only finitely many lamps c_x, and its T_alpha-coordinates lie in one Gamma_n. Already-landed carrier.

Let Y be the union of the Gamma_n-orbits of these finitely many x. Then Y is finite and Gamma_n-invariant, and the finite subset is contained in C_Y rtimes Gamma_n, where C_Y=<epsilon,c_y:y in Y> is finite. Already-landed carrier.
This semidirect product is residually finite. Indeed,... the element has nontrivial image in the finite group C_Y rtimes (Gamma_n/J). Already-landed carrier.

Therefore every finitely generated subgroup of W_0 is residually finite, hence sofic. Already-landed carriers; also leanverified via CliffordWitnessLocallyRFByInt.manuscriptShiftKernelForIsLocallyResiduallyFinite.
The group W_0 is their directed union, and W/W_0 = Z is amenable. Already-landed carrier.
Soficity passes to directed unions and to extensions with amenable quotient [Elek-Szabo Thm 1], so W is sofic. Already-landed carrier.
Proposition clifford-self-embedding shows that it is not MF. Already-landed carrier.

By Proposition locally-rf-by-z-trace,... the canonical trace of C*_max(W_0) is quasidiagonal and that of C*_max(W) is amenable; by Theorem factorization-nonmf-trace the latter is not quasidiagonal. Already-landed carrier.
For a concrete instance, take Gamma-bar = Z^3 rtimes SL_3(Z) = {...} <= GL_4(Z). Pure naming of the concrete group.
It is residually finite, since reduction modulo a suitable integer separates any two distinct integral matrices. Already leanverified in the tex.
and it has property (T) [BHV Example 1.7.4(i)]. Already leanverified in the tex.

Let D=diag(2,2,2,1), alpha(g)=DgD^{-1}, so that alpha(v,A)=(2v,A). Already-landed carrier (independent matrix model AffineSL3Doubling, feeding the same index-eight computation via LiteralAffineRangeIndexEight).

This is injective,... so [Gamma-bar:alpha(Gamma-bar)]=8. New theorem in this landing at the literal gammaBar/conjD model the rest of the development actually uses (ExplicitLinearModel.conjD_injective + AmenableTraceTheorem.manuscriptAffineCliffordHypotheses). NOTE: "its image consists of the affine matrices whose translation coordinates are all even" is proved at the independent matrix model instead: GroupApproximation.AffineSL3Doubling.mem_range_alpha_iff, which LiteralAffineRangeIndexEight.lean shows feeds the same index computation for gammaBar; not restated for gammaBar's own six-generator presentation.
Translation a by the first standard basis vector lies outside alpha(Gamma-bar). Already-landed carrier (manuscriptAffineCliffordHypotheses), also reused by the new sentence-level wrapper.
So the preceding construction applies to Gamma-bar, alpha and a. Already-landed carriers.
